name: What kind of foundation is used for landlord-ready tiny homes?

mainEntity.name: What kind of foundation is used for landlord-ready tiny homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Landlord-ready tiny homes, especially those intended for permanent rental use as ADUs, typically require a permanent foundation. This can include a concrete slab, a raised foundation with a crawl space, or pier and beam systems, depending on the site conditions and local building codes. The chosen foundation ensures the structural integrity and longevity of the home, as well as compliance with local regulations for permanent structures. We assess your property to recommend the most suitable foundation type.
acceptedAnswer.description: Landlord-ready tiny homes for permanent rental use require a permanent foundation, such as a concrete slab or raised foundation, for structural integrity and code compliance.
